ui.volumeRows: Windows WPF acceptance compared each real collected volume with the rendered row and required its confirmed disk numbers or explicit unavailable label.
ui.physicalDiskRows: Windows WPF acceptance compares physical disk rows in provider order, then checks the displayed number or explicit unavailable text. Disk names are not assumed unique.
ui.multipleAndUnavailableFormatting: Unit acceptance verifies multiple disk numbers and both null and empty mappings.

ciPreviousAttempt.cause: The Windows VM exposes two physical disk rows with the same model name; the test incorrectly assumed disk names were unique.
ciPreviousAttempt.resolution: Compare rendered physical disk rows in provider order and assert each disk number instead of selecting a row by model name.

portablePackage.smoke: Main window opened, responded, and closed cleanly.

limitations: This PC exposed one fixed volume and one physical provider disk during the sample.
Multiple-disk and unknown mappings are verified by explicit formatting tests; a multi-disk physical machine was not available for this run.
Storage reliability counters are not exposed by this PC's provider and remain unavailable.
